pages.text: One ordinary egg, eight extraordinary scales, and a full day of patience.
Eight $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_queen)Queen Scales$() pressed around one ordinary chicken egg. The scales do the heavy lifting; the egg mostly signs the paperwork.

pages.title: The Brooding
pages.text: Set the egg in the Aether's Incubator and keep the flame fed with ambrosium torches. Brooding takes 24,000 ticks — one full Minecraft day, twenty real minutes, zero shortcuts.$(p)Long incubation, longer loyalty. Pressing the egg earns Royal Brood; the hatching earns Long Live.

pages.title: The Imprint
pages.text: The Prince hatches already tamed: he imprints on the nearest face within ten blocks the moment he draws breath. Stand by the incubator for the finale — this is not the moment to go check on the farm.$(p)What walks out is a living trophy that follows you home. The Court considers the matter of succession settled.

pages.name: The Prince
pages.text: Her $(l:orespawn_integrations:her_side/the_diary)diary$() has strong opinions about his flyovers. He has never once read the reviews.
